description: What the remote WhatsApp Web page may call through bridge.js: notifications, the unread count, diagnostic breadcrumbs and the download toast's Open/Show buttons. core:default is intentionally NOT granted so the remote origin cannot emit/listen on internal event channels or introspect the app, and of the notification plugin only its read-only permission query is granted: its init script asks it on every page load (refused, that logged an unhandled rejection), while its `notify` would bypass the lock-aware `notify` and stays denied.
